General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM bracket which bolts to the vehicle frame and secures the transfer case via rubber mounts which bolt directly between the bracket and the transfer case.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 LH Mount Bracket for Transfer Case
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
